scenario: Impure call embedded inside a let RHS (rather than being the entire RHS) rejects with DS_VALIDATE_LET_IMPURE_EMBEDDED per LGRA.9.8 / LLET.10. The let-RHS purity gate per LGRA.9.8.4 requires impure builtins (`sync_impure` / `async`) to be the entire RHS so the lowerer can route them to the right tier; nested impure calls would require auto-hoisting which is deferred. Pin: `let v = abs(cached("k"))` — `cached()` is sync-impure and is wrapped inside `abs()`, so the let RHS classifier returns 'impure_embedded'.
